The '''sea serpent''' was a [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] creature that lived in the [[Water/Legends|waters]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. One such creature had a head the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human's]] torso and attacked a [[Boat/Legends|boat]] in which [[Dalien Brock|Dalien]] and [[Lanoree Brock]] were riding.<ref name="Into the Void" />
